svg.aria-label: Photos quick card: take photos in the camera app, attach them in the form, and upload when you have signal.
svg.text: DRYSPACE SOLUTIONS
PHOTOS — QUICK CARD
Getting site photos off your device and into SharePoint
New in v1.3
TAKE PHOTOS IN THE CAMERA APP, NOT IN THE FORM
Then attach them. Your camera roll keeps a second copy, and location detail survives.
ON SITE — NO SIGNAL NEEDED
Photograph what you need, using the Camera app
Take as many as you like. Nothing is uploading yet, so nothing is waiting on signal.
Attach them to the right field in the form
Tap the upload box in that section and pick them from your Photo Library.
BACK IN SIGNAL — CAR, OFFICE OR WIFI
Sign in, once
Home screen → Sign in. Use your Dryspace Microsoft account. It remembers you.
Tap “Upload now”
The home screen tells you how many files are waiting. Leave it running until it finishes.
Check it says “All photos uploaded”
That is your confirmation. Until it does, the photos exist only on your device.
WHAT THE APP DOES BY ITSELF
Keeps a full-quality original for evidence, plus a smaller copy so reports stay emailable.
Names every file by job, date and which part of the form it came from.
Files them into the inspection’s own photos/ folder — you never choose a location.
Reads every upload back and checks it arrived complete before counting it as done.
IF SOMETHING LOOKS WRONG
“No connection”
Normal in a basement. Try again when you have signal.
“Please sign in again”
Tap Sign in. Nothing is lost — the photos are still on the device.
“Need attention”
Tap Try again. If it repeats, tell the office before deleting anything.
Never delete an inspection until the home screen says all photos are uploaded.
Dryspace Site Inspection App v1.3
